## Definition of Done Checklist
<!-- All items must be checked before the PR can be merged -->

### Code Quality
- [ ] The code is fully implemented, typed, and functional
- [ ] All logic is correctly categorized into screens, components, hooks, state, etc.
- [ ] Code follows the project's folder structure and naming conventions
- [ ] Domain logic is properly segregated (business logic separate from UI)
- [ ] No console.log or debugging code left in the codebase
- [ ] Code is DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) and follows SOLID principles where applicable

### Testing
- [ ] The app runs without crashes on iOS
- [ ] The app runs without crashes on Android
- [ ] Unit tests are written/updated and passing
- [ ] Integration tests are written/updated and passing
- [ ] E2E tests are written/updated and passing (if applicable)
- [ ] Test coverage is maintained or improved

### Code Standards
- [ ] TypeScript passes with no errors (`npm run type-check`)
- [ ] ESLint passes without issues (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Prettier formatting is applied (`npm run format:check`)
- [ ] All CI checks are passing

### Documentation
- [ ] Code is self-documenting with clear variable/function names
- [ ] Complex logic includes inline comments explaining the "why"
- [ ] README is updated if new features/setup steps are added
- [ ] API changes are documented
- [ ] CHANGELOG is updated (if applicable)

### Review
- [ ] Self-review completed
- [ ] Code has been reviewed by at least one team member
- [ ] All review comments have been addressed
- [ ] No merge conflicts with the target branch
